request.text:
Employee ticket:
VPN error 809 again, it drops every five minutes. Same thing my Windows colleague had last week.

Knowledge base:
[1] VPN drops every few minutes on Windows · Symptoms
## Symptoms
The Northwind VPN disconnects every few minutes on a Windows 11 laptop, sometimes with error 809. It usually follows a Windows update that changed the network adapter driver.

[2] VPN drops every few minutes on macOS · Symptoms
## Symptoms
The Northwind VPN connects, then disconnects every few minutes. macOS may show error 809 or "The VPN server did not respond". It often starts after a macOS or VPN client update, because the update leaves a stale VPN profile behind.

[3] VPN drops every few minutes on macOS · If it still drops
## If it still drops
If the VPN still drops after the reset, the problem is usually the network you are on. Try a phone hotspot for five minutes. If the hotspot is stable, the issue is your local Wi-Fi; if not, raise a ticket so Network Operations can check your account.
